jer_hougue_curator.text: La Hougue Bie is a passage tomb, built about 3500 BC. It's a long passage, and at the equinox the sun's first beams reach right to the back. Inside, you crouch, and you can imagine them gathering to honour their dead.

A medieval chapel and then a Jersey legend were added on top. And a German bunker, because every hill had one in the war. The Occupation Museum shares the site. Thousands of years in one little mound.
